_about: Co-folding targets. The protein sequence is the full deposited sequence of the entity (SEQRES), fetched from RCSB; the ligand is given as its CCD code. build_data.py writes an AlphaFold Server style job JSON for each, which LocalFold (localfold.org) and AlphaFold Server can read.

targets.note: Small ligand in a well-defined pocket.
The practical's main case. Larger, so slower in the browser.
